title: config.get
description: Every setting's current value, its default (betaconfig.py's, absent when betaconfig.py has none) and where the value came from: default, local (the local config) or run (an override in this request). paths limits the answer to settings at or under those dotted paths. overrides are per-run values, applied for this answer only and never written; one that would fail validation answers config.invalid, a path that is no setting config.unknown_key.
